result.planSummary: Implemented deterministic draft Thread View rebuild with explicit input validation, band-budget allocation, persisted chunk-backed lower-band materialization, draft persistence, and Story 4 regression coverage for builder and materializer behavior.

changedFiles.reason: Implemented Story 4 deterministic rebuild flow, including input validation, band allocation, contiguous turn/chunk selection, threshold reporting, and draft Thread View persistence.
Implemented production lower-band materialization from persisted chunk state and kept upper-band materialization/order handling under the new thread-view surface.
Repointed the legacy context-workbench materializer surface at the new thread-view implementation so existing callers share the same production logic.
Added Story 4 test seeding helpers for deterministic turns, chunks, placeholder variants, and draft-view fixtures.
Added Story 4 builder coverage for explicit inputs, newest-first turn selection, lower-band chunk eligibility, threshold success/failure, and missing-placeholder rejection.
Added Story 4 materializer coverage for band-order preservation and empty-band safety with real lower-band chunk selections.
Updated the foundation smoke check to reflect the builder’s implemented dependency contract instead of the old scaffold stub.

findingsFixed: Replaced the Story 4 builder stub with real deterministic rebuild logic and persisted-draft updates.
Replaced lower-band carry-forward behavior with real chunk-backed materialization and validation against persisted placeholder artifacts.
Fixed lower-band candidate rollover so brief-band selection continues from the first unselected older chunk after detailed-band allocation.
findingsSurfaced: Raw full-fidelity threshold accounting is still based on deterministic structured-content estimates because Story 4 does not define an exact tokenizer contract.

openQuestions: Should Story 5 or later switch rebuild threshold accounting to the PI-target tokenizer once the PI file builder exists, or is the current deterministic estimator the intended long-term contract?
result.recommendedNextStep: Run verifier review against Story 4 with focus on threshold-accounting expectations and reuse the new builder/materializer path in Story 5 smart-compact orchestration.
